title: Algebraic stalk tower with separate local markings
statement: Let X be Noetherian, g:Y to X an immersion, d an adic coefficient datum on A, and M a normalized adic tower as in [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Suppose every M_n is separately bounded and its inverse image along g, after the specified finite constant coefficient restriction, has relatively finite lisse cohomology in every degree. Put C=AdicCompletion(d.ideal,A) and J=d.ideal*C. There is a covering sieve V on the final object of Y.ProEt. For every U to the final object in V there is a tower K_n in D(C/J^(n+1)) with consecutive arrows t_n universal for exact quotient scalar restriction, transferring each vanishing cohomology of M_n and having finite module cohomology. Every refinement W to U has the given relative finite-lisse cohomology after restriction along W.hom followed by g. For each n separately there is a covering sieve T_n on U, such that each W to U in T_n carries a derived isomorphism from constantAdicQuotientRealization(W.hom followed by g,d,n)(K_n) to the actual inverse image of M_n. There is no simultaneous cover of all the T_n and no compatibility of these isomorphisms in the conclusion. All constant quotient realizations and coefficient maps are the specified ones of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison].

proof.text: Obtain connected etale origins with their actual geometric stalks and normalized stalk arrows. For a member of the sieve generated by this etale cover, retain the chart stalks and their universal transitions. No local marking has yet been asserted.

An exact geometric stalk sends each zero cohomology of the etale origin to zero, and its derived homology comparison transfers this to the stalk complex. Finite locally constant cohomology has finitely generated stalks. Transfer this property through the universe-lift and derived homology isomorphisms.

The canonical map from A/I^(n+1) to C/J^(n+1) is bijective, so the latter ring is finite. Apply the connected-stalk clause of finite-ring derived local constancy to each etale origin separately. Pull that cover back to any chosen pro-etale refinement of the original chart and generate its covering sieve. Every member factors through a pulled-back chart, so the conditional transport gives precisely the required constantAdicQuotientRealization isomorphism. Covers are allowed to depend on n.

Generate the outer covering sieve from the connected etale cover, transporting along the unique isomorphism from the identity chart to the chosen terminal object. Factor every member through its original chart. Compose refinement arrows for inherited relative lissity, and retain the separate marking sieves just constructed. All constructions also apply to empty covers.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_tower_stalk_level_models
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (g : Y ⟶ X) [IsImmersion g]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)))
    (hlisse : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
      IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
        ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
              ((adicTowerPullback g ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) :
    let C := AdicCompletion d.ideal A
    let J := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A C)
    ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ Y.ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology Y (⊤_ Y.ProEt) ∧
      ∀ (U : Y.ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ Y.ProEt), V f →
        ∃ (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))))
          (t : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
              (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                  (K n)),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1)))),
            Function.Bijective (fun k : K n ⟶ N ↦ t n ≫
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
                (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.map
                    k)) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (M.level n)) →
            IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n))) ∧
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Module.Finite (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (C ⧸ J ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n))) ∧
          (∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
            IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule (W.hom ≫ g) (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))
              ((pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage (W.hom ≫ g)).map
                (pbcLevelConstantComparison X d n).hom)).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                    ((adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
                      ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))))) ∧
          ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
            ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
              Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (K n) ≅
                (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
                  ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))
